jobs_results.title: Salesforce Consultant
jobs_results.description:
Omega CRM is a Merkle & Dentsu company, leader in development of Customer Experience services, with +20 years of experience in the use of Technology applied to Marketing and providing a unique Customer Relationship with mainly focus on Innovation is looking for a Salesforce Consultant.

Job Description
• Requirements Analysis.
• Design and implement functional solutions in projects.
• Provide effort estimations for projects.
• Work in coordination with the rest of the Omega team and/or the client to contribute to the fulfillment of project objectives.
• Analyze and improve application performance.
• Collaborate with technology providers when required by the project.
• Contribute to the validation of the solution against functional requirements.
• Comply with the agreed software quality standards set by Omega's Technical Management.
• Generate functional documentation for completed projects.
• Collaborate within Omega's community of practice by sharing knowledge.

Required Experience
•... Minimum of 4 years work experience with Salesforce administration, configuration and consulting roles
• Experience in Field Service is a plus.
• Experience with different clouds such as Sales, Service, Community, etc.
• Experience with Agile methodology.

Skills
• Oral and written fluent in English.
• French as a plus.

What Do We Offer
• Permanent contract.
• Flexible Schedule. We make it easy. Balance your professional and personal life.
• Certifications plan. Improve your skills and get the official certificate from our main partners.
• Home Office. You decide and we support you.
• Flexible retribution (public transport ticket, Ticket restaurtant, …).
• Health insurance.
• OMEGA in action. Our commitment to a better society is not just an intention
• Professional development: Evolve, grow and get where you want to go.

About Us

Our mission is to accelerate the business experience (BX) of its customers. In concrete terms, our 360 solutions allow business transformation and acceleration by means of technology and data applied to Customer #OmnichannelExperiences in fields such as #CustomerServices, #eCommerce, #Analytics or #Marketing. We target companies from different fields such as: #Retail, , #Manufacturing but also #Education, #NonProfit, #NGO etc. We are one of the top 3 partners of #Salesforce in Europe. Our team is composed of more than 500 people of 24 nationalities based in Spain and France, who have wide knowledge and experience that understands business processes and technology while enjoying what it does. Key to our success is the knowledge of our people. We are an innovation and Outstanding Knowledge award-winning, Salesforce Consulting Partner. Our priority is the well-being of the team. We foster a collaborative culture, involved and supported by our company values: #Talent, #flexibility, #commitment and #innovation. We bring them to everything we do. #TogetherWeGrow

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Analyst (English Speaker)
jobs_results.description:
Our client is currently in search of an Technical Analyst in the vibrant city of Barcelona. If you possess a strong functional and technical business analytical mindset and have previous experience, this opportunity is made for you. Join an expanding international team that boasts a strong global presence across Europe.

Tasks
• Work with 3rd party vendors to define best development practices and ensure they are being followed.
• Involved in technical assessment of solutions & peer review of code from other developers.
• Help, where required, the technical support team to analyse production incidents and to reach a solution.
• Co-ordinate with testing, security, functional consultants to ensure Salesforce solutions adhere to functional, non-functional & Security requirements.
• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Salesforce solutions.
• Stay up to date with the latest Salesforce features, technologies, and trends.
• Work with technical team for adaption of new ... decommission of outgoing salesforce features.
• Provide support to Salesforce users when necessary.
• Engage with Page’s Vendor management team on optimum license utilisation.
• Collaborate with other IT teams to integrate Salesforce with chosen enterprise systems.
• Provide technical guidance and maintenance for backup and deployments.

Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
• 3+ years of experience as a Salesforce Technical or a similar role.
• Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, development methodologies, and best practices
• Excellent understanding of data modelling and data migration principles
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Salesforce Certified Administrator certification
• Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder certification
• Experience with Salesforce Lightning Experience (LEX) development

Benefits
• Salary aligned with your experience and the market
• Health and life insurance (after 6 months)
• Meal vouchers
• Hybrid model (3 days per week on-site)
• Office in Barcelona
• International work environment
• Career growth opportunities
• Starting date: ASAP

An international SSC widley acknowledged as an excellent service provider for companies all over Europe is looking for experts in finance, adminstration, marketing, IT, HR and recruitment to join their hub in Barcelona. They offer dynamic and multicultural environment with a team including talents from more than 30 different nationalities working on high-quality standards

jobs_results.title: Salesforce - Consultor Funcional Junior
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres cambiar el mundo? Eso es lo que hacemos en Cabify. Nuestro objetivo es hacer de las ciudades mejores lugares para vivir, mejorando la movilidad de las personas que viven en ellas, conectando a pasajeros y conductores con tan sólo pulsar un botón. Es posible que algún día las ciudades sean lugares donde nadie necesite un coche privado, pero aún nos queda un largo camino por recorrer… ¿nos acompañas?

Esta persona será responsable de dar soporte al desarrollo continuo de nuestro despliegue de Salesforce. mejorar los procesos y la adopción utilizando la plataforma CRM y todas las demás herramientas de ventas. Trabajará en estrecha colaboración con el jefe de Enablement, el jefe de operaciones de ventas, el desarrollador de Salesforce y otras partes interesadas (Equipos de producto, Marketing Digital, CRM) para identificar, desarrollar e implantar nuevos procesos empresariales. Su principal responsabilidad es coordinar y ejecutar la configuración diaria, el soporte, el... mantenimiento, la formación y la mejora de nuestra plataforma CRM.

Cómo lo harás:
• Dar soporte a la plataforma Salesforce y otras herramientas de ventas (adición de nuevos usuarios, informes y cuadros de mando, objetos personalizados, creación de nuevos campos, tipos de registro, modificación de diseños de página, procesos de aprobación).
• Proporcionar asistencia diaria al usuario final y ayudar a los usuarios con las mejores prácticas para mejorar y aumentar su conocimiento de Salesforce.
• Gestionar el soporte de tickets de Salesforce
• Asistencia para integraciones y aplicaciones y soluciones de terceros
• Implementar, mantener y mejorar las personalizaciones de Salesforce, como la seguridad, el uso compartido y la visibilidad, los procesos de aprobación, los componentes de iluminación, el generador de procesos, las reglas de validación y los informes.
• Promover y mantener la integridad de los datos y tomando las medidas adecuadas para garantizar que se siguen las buenas prácticas (reglas de validación, reglas de correspondencia y reglas de duplicación).

Lo que buscamos
• Experiencia de al menos 2 años en Salesforce
• Experiencia de administración en un gran entorno de Salesforce (más de 200 usuarios)
• Experiencia en configuración de Salesforce: Modelado de datos, Reglas de validación, Formatos de página, Procesos de aprobación…
• Conocimientos avanzados de manipulación masiva de datos en el sistema (actualización, carga, fusión)
• Experiencia en desarrollo en lenguaje Apex. Experiencia en el desarrollo de triggers, clases y extensiones de Apex.
• Desarrollo de Flujos y Procesos: Capacidad para diseñar y desarrollar flujos de trabajo y procesos de automatización (Flows, Workflows…)
• Integraciones: Experiencia en integración de Salesforce con sistemas externos utilizando API REST y SOAP.
• Desarrollo de AURA y Lightning Web Components: Familiaridad con el desarrollo de componentes web.
• Base de Datos y SOQL: Habilidades avanzadas en la escritura de consultas SOQL (Salesforce Object Query Language).
• Gestión de datos: Experiencia en la migración y manipulación de datos utilizando Data Loader u otras herramientas de gestión de datos.
• Deseable experiencia en la creación de informes, cuadros de mando y documentación de procesos.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Somos una empresa llena de gente feliz y motivada… ¡y no queremos que eso cambie! Aquí te mostramos algunas razones por las que te encantará formar parte de la familia Cabify.
• Contrato indefinido con salario competitivo.
• Recharge day.
• Crédito mensual en nuestra App de Cabify.
• Retribución flexible en tickets restaurant, transporte, seguro médico y guarderías.
• Una sala de mascotas en la oficina para que no tengas que dejar a tu peludo amigo en casa.
• Todo el equipamiento que necesites (tú solo tienes que poner tu talento).
• Y lo último, pero no menos importante... ¡café gratis

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Administrator
jobs_results.description:
Brief Summary of role:

As our organization grows, so does the need for streamlined Salesforce processes and functionalities. Your role as a Salesforce Administrator is crucial in addressing user cases, extending access, and implementing new features to enhance our Salesforce environment. By staying up to date with Salesforce releases and utilizing declarative development tools, you'll ensure our internal teams have the tools they need for success. Your work in managing access, building reports, and configuring the platform with Copado will directly support our business's scalability and efficiency. You'll report to the Salesforce Platform Manager, becoming a key player in our expanding Salesforce team.

What you’ll be doing:
• Addressing Cases from internal users, including requests to extend access or visibility in Salesforce, new licenses, or requests for new features and functionality.
• Evaluating requests for new features or functionality for feasibility and priority before... handing them over to the Salesforce Development Team.
• Building reports and dashboards for the teams.
• Keeping up to date with the most recent updates and new functionality released by Salesforce every scheduled release.
• Creating and developing functionality using declarative development tools, such as Flows, Lightning App Builder, Formulas, and Approval Processes.
• Granting access to other platforms outside of Salesforce, such as Outreach, Gong.
• Exhibiting a mentality of customer service to enable the success of users in our internal teams.
• Managing Salesforce roles, profiles, sharing rules, workflows, and groups.
• Hands-on configuration of the Salesforce platform utilizing Copado.

We are looking for someone with:
• 4+ years of experience as a Salesforce Administrator.
• 4+ years of experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
• 3+ years of hands-on experience in creating and developing functionality using declarative development tools, such as Flows, Lightning App Builder, Formulas, and Approval Processes.
• Proven experience collecting requirements and translating them into technical specifications.
• Experience training end users in new functionalities.
• Capable in the use of Apex Data Loader and other tools relevant to the platform.
• Certifications: Salesforce Certified Administrator.
• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience required.

Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:

Salesforce Advanced Administrator, or ability to this certification during the first two years of employment. Salesforce Platform App Builder, or ability to obtain this certification during the first year of employment. Knowledge of Copado (preferred).Knowledge of the following: Salesforce, CI/CD, Agile methodologies

Copado is Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Copado does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Copado will not pay any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Copado

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Technical Lead
jobs_results.description:
OCA Global somos un grupo internacional de capital privado referente en Inspección, Inspección de vehículos, Certificación, Ensayos, Consultoría, Prevención, Formación, Sostenibilidad y Medio Ambiente, con más de 12 años de experiencia.

Somos un equipo de más de 4.000 personas, distribuidos en una red de más de 90 oficinas en todo el mundo, y prestamos nuestros servicios en más de 60 países, haciendo posible un mundo mejor, garantizando que nada quede al azar y con un alto compromiso en todo lo que hacemos.

Debido a nuestro crecimiento y expansión precisamos incorporar un/a Salesforce Technical Lead para el departamento de IT en nuestras oficinas centrales ubicadas en Sant Cugat.

En Dependencia directa del Responsable, tu misión será contribuir al éxito operativo y estratégico de la empresa mediante el diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento eficiente soluciones Salesforce.

Tus funciones principales serán:
• Diseñar, implementar y probar nuevas funcionalidades y características en
•... Salesforce para satisfacer las necesidades de la compañia.
• Desarrollo, test y despliegue de desarrollos en código Apex.
• Colaborar con el equipo interno y externo garantizando que se cumplan las
• mejores prácticas.
• Tutorizar al resto del equipo interno.
• Definir/Refinar el flujo de trabajo del equipo de desarrollo
• Hacer un uso adecuado de las diferentes alternativas del entorno Salesforce (Flows, Apex, LWC, etc.) para garantizar la cobertura de los requerimientos.

¿Qué requerimientos precisas para la posición?
• Experiencia de 2 años en puesto similar.
• Título universitario en Informática, Ingeniería de Sistemas o relacionado.
• Nivel de inglés B2.
• Experiencia con Salesforce en sus diferentes nubes, así como del ecosistema Salesforce.
• Experiencia en proporcionar e implementar soluciones técnicas.
• Conocimiento avanzado en Apex, Visualforce, Componentes Lightning para la creación de soluciones personalizadas adaptadas a las necesidades de negocio.
• Sólido conocimiento de los límites de Salesforce y los procesos de testing.
• Conocimiento de procesos de release management y del uso de herramientas de gestión de código y de despliegeue como github o bitbucket.
• Experiencia en integración con otros sistemas utilizando SOAP y REST. Conocimiento de integración utilizando Mulesoft es un plus.

¿Qué competencias buscamos?
• Orientación a cliente, capacidad de comunicación efectiva, trabajo en equipo y liderazgo.

Se valorará...
• Contar con certificaciones de Salesforce en el ámbito de desarrollo.

¿Qué te ofrece OCA Global?
• Contrato indefinido a Jornada completa.
• Horario de Lunes a Jueves, jornada completa. Viernes jornada intensiva.
• Horario intensivo durante Agosto y vísperas de festivo
• Día 24 y 31 de Diciembre festivo.
• Formar parte de un grupo empresarial con crecimiento constante en un sector en auge.

(Si tienes una minusvalía del 33% o mayor acreditada por un Organismos Oficial háznoslo saber, nos interesa hablar contigo)

Si crees que este puede ser tu siguiente paso profesional envíanos tu candidatura y la analizaremos en detalle. Nos encantará poder charlar contigo.

Te invitamos a visitar nuestra página web www.ocaglobal.com donde podrás saber más sobre nosotros.

¿Quiénes somos?

Desde OCA Global Corporate trabajamos conjuntamente para ofrecer servicio y soporte a todas las líneas de negocio del grupo, con el objetivo de ayudarles a crecer y desarrollarse

jobs_results.title: CRM Salesforce Developer (Madrid)
jobs_results.description:
At PayRetailers, we are committed to providing cutting-edge solutions that empower businesses to succeed in Latin America. Our collaborative and inclusive work environment encourages creativity and growth, where every employee's contribution is valued. Get ready to embark on an exciting journey with us, as we strive to make a meaningful impact on the world of payments.

Our team is looking for a Salesforce Developer. In this role you will be responsible for managing, configuring, customizing, and developing solutions on the Salesforce platform to meet the organization's business needs. You will be the focal point for system administration, implementing new functionality, integrating with external systems, and developing custom solutions to improve the efficiency and productivity of Salesforce users.

Job Duties & Responsibilities:
• Manage and maintain the Salesforce platform, including configuring users, profiles, permissions, roles, workflows, validation rules, and automation... processes.
• Collaborate with sales, marketing and service teams to understand their requirements and translate them into technical solutions using Salesforce.
• Develop and customize solutions in Salesforce using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components and other Salesforce development tools (integrations with Jira / Freshdesk / others).
• Design and implement integrations between Salesforce and other business systems using REST APIs, SOAP or other integration technologies.
• Design and develop custom Salesforce solutions using declarative features such as Process Builder, Flow and Workflow Rules, as well as programmatic solutions using Apex and Visualforce.
• Perform extensive testing and debugging solutions to ensure quality and stability of implementations.
• Provide technical support to Salesforce users, resolve issues, answer questions, and offer training when necessary.
• Stay abreast of the latest Salesforce updates and features and evaluate their impact on the organization.
• Document technical specifications, design decisions, and code changes.
• Perform unit testing, integration testing, and troubleshooting to ensure reliability and performance of Salesforce solutions.

Experience and Qualifications:
• Demonstrated experience as a Salesforce Administrator and Developer, with a minimum of 5 years of experience configuring and customizing Salesforce.
• Experience with Java.
• Experience with integrations in salesforce cloud (marketing y sales).
• Experiencie working technical documentation with users.
• Salesforce Certifications such as Administrator (ADM-201) and Developer (DEV-401 or equivalent) are highly desirable.
• Experience designing and implementing integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST APIs, SOAP, or other integration technologies.
• Hands-on experience with Salesforce integration tools such as Salesforce Connect, MuleSoft, or Informatica.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a dynamic environment.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

What we offer:
• Competitive salary! 💶
• Opportunities to grow within a company in hypergrowth stage.
• Additional days of holidays! ✈
• Free language classes 👨🏫
• Private health insurance covered by the company.🩺
• At least one day of teleworking per week 💻
• Free catering in the office 🥣
• Possibility to increase your net salary through our flexible retribution partner! 🍕
• Excellent work environment and good collaboration ✌️
• Free coffee/Tea and snacks from the company☕🥐

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Administrator
jobs_results.description:
The role

As a Salesforce Administrator, your primary role entails the administration, configuration, maintenance, and development of new objects and functionalities within the company's Salesforce product ecosystem.

Who we are looking for:

A minimum of 2 years of work experience as a Salesforce Administrator, including:
• Managing and configuring Salesforce products, including roles, profiles, permissions, user management, data structures, and Lightning components
• Managing and optimizing Salesforce product licensing
• Creating and maintaining Salesforce objects, products, and data structures
• Creating Salesforce data dashboards and reports on demand
• Skill in using and maintaining the Service Cloud console and knowledge of DataLoader CLI

Additionally, the following qualifications are advantageous:
• Experience in training users and developing training materials.
• Familiarity with managing Milestones/Entitlements (SLAs), Approval rules, Knowledge, and Validation... rules

Education, Language and others:
• University degree or higher education
• Fluent in Spanish and English
• Certifications: Salesforce Administrator, Platform Developer, and App Builder
• Other: APEX, ERP systems (preferably SAGE), Tableau, Marketing Cloud,
• Knowledge of integrations using RESTful APIs and Web Services for third-party integration, Programming knowledge using VSCode and GIT desirable

Why should you join us?
• Permanent contract
• Salary between 36.000 - 42.000 € annual gross
• Flexible schedule and hybrid work
• Stunning and recently established offices located in the heart of Barcelona! Access to coffee and fresh fruit.
• Birthday Gift: Enjoy an AIRE experience on your birthday!
• Discounts: Benefit from 30% off on all our AIRE experiences
• Inclusive Work Environment: At AIRE, team spirit is our greatest asset! We are proud to have a welcoming and inclusive work environment where everyone's opinions and backgrounds are heard and respected. 💜

Key Responsibilities

Platform Administration
• Manage the technical and administrative aspects of the company's Salesforce products
• Handle roles, profiles, rules, workflows, and user management for Salesforce products
• Perform data maintenance, loading, and extraction, as well as create dashboards and reports on request
• Create and maintain new products, objects, and rules as requested by other areas of the company

User Services
• Provide direct support to users in various markets
• Manage Salesforce licenses and escalate issues as needed
• Prepare training materials and provide training to platform users
• User training
• Communicate new functionalities.

Innovation
• Enhancements for user interface usability
• Collect, analyze, and prioritize requests for enhancements and manage their implementation with external suppliers
• Propose improvements in the use and implementation of tools

About Us:

AIRE Ancient Baths are temples dedicated to the creation of the ultimate relaxation experience, where time does not exist. Inspired by the tradition of baths from ancient Roman, Greek, and Ottoman civilizations, the AIRE Experience always takes place in restored historical buildings in the center of globally acclaimed cities.

At AIRE we are proud to have an international presence with 8 established sites: NYC, Chicago, London, Copenhagen, Barcelona, Sevilla, Almería, and Vallromanes. We are already looking into the future and moving onwards, with our soon-to-be-opened, Upper East Side and Toronto-2024- facilities

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Functional Consultant
jobs_results.description:
Role Description

We are still looking for the very Top Talent…and we would be delighted if you were to join our team!

More in details, UST is a multinational company based in North America, certified as a Top Employer company with over 30.000 employees all over the world and presence in more than 30 countries. We are leaders on digital technology services, and we provide large-scale technologic solutions to big companies.

What we look for?

For our specialized team, we are looking for a Salesforce Functional Consultant to support with requirements gathering, data mapping, data transformation and data dictionary to help deliver integrated solution Job with an international banking client. High level of English required.

Valuable and desirable: being entitled of Disability Certificate (at least 33% score).

Key Responsibilities
• Become the conduit between the Business and Technology teams
• Support business discovery, leading on Salesforce discovery aspects
• Work closely with... Business Analysts to understand future state business processes, ensuring appropriate user story coverage
• Create Figma wireframes using Salesforce plugin to aid discovery and requirement definition
• Help drive the correct story structure and story size to for a logical Salesforce delivery
• Conduct functional reviews of developed stories to ensure they meet the business needs prior to passing to QA
• Help drive the client acceptance testing process to identify required changes and communicate changes to the development team
• Support or delivery demos to core team and wider stakeholders

Mandatory Requirement
• Excellent Communication skills and mastery of the English language
• Experience in designing declarative solutions
• 3+ years' experience supporting Salesforce technical implementations
• Attention to detail
• Excellent communication skills, ability to liaise with senior stakeholder and communicate complex issues in a simple way
• Excellent knowledge Salesforce Experience Cloud
• Experience in working in both agile and waterfall methodologies

Desired Requirements
• Experience working in a highly regulated environment, like banking
• Financial Services industry experience, preferably within mortgages
• Experience implementing Experience Cloud solutions at enterprise organisations
• Financial Services Cloud Partner Accreditation Qualities
• Adaptable to diverse set of technical responsibilities
• Bachelor degree in Computer Science / Information Technology or a related field, or substantial practical experience of software delivery at an advanced level

What can we offer?
• 23 days of Annual Leave plus the 24th and 31st of December as discretionary days!
• Numerous benefits (Heath Care Plan, Internet Connectivity, Life and Accident Insurances).
• `Retribución Flexible´ Program: (Meals, Kinder Garden, Transport, online English lessons, Heath Care Plan…)
• Free access to several training platforms
• Professional stability and career plans
• UST also, compensates referrals from which you could benefit when you refer professionals.
• The option to pick between 12 or 14 payments along the year.
• Real Work Life Balance measures (flexibility, WFH or remote work policy, compacted hours during summertime…)
• UST Club Platform discounts and gym Access discounts

If you would like to know more, do not hesitate to apply and we’ll get in touch to fill you in details. UST is waiting for you!

In UST we are committed to equal opportunities in our selection processes and do not discriminate based on race, gender, disability, age, religion, sexual orientation or nationality.

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Administrator (Remote)
jobs_results.description:
Beyondsoft (listed by the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, stock code 002649) is a global provider of IT consulting, product and solution services. Relying on strong R&D and innovation capabilities, the company widely adopts emerging technologies based on big data and mobile internet, including big data management platform, enterprise risk warning and public opinion monitoring system, AI-based intelligent operation and maintenance service, and intelligent automated test products. And a wide range of products and solutions, including internationally authoritative software testing qualification training, for a wide range of services in the fields of high technology, internet, finance, retail, logistics, energy, manufacturing and medical.

We are looking for a Salesforce Administrator to work with an Entertainment Provider.

The role can be performed from any city within Spain and will work with a team based in Costa Rica, so we are looking for someone able to work full time 8 hours day from... 14:00h onwards with flexibility.

Key job responsibilities
• Own various technical aspects of the company Salesforce instance such as integrations with internal tools, data quality, platform hygiene, systems configuration and maintenance, notification announcements, environment refresh, and AppExchange products.
• Manage configuration of new and existing Salesforce features including user management, security, custom objects, page layouts, validations, workflows, flows, process builders, and other 3rd party applications.
• Partner with other system product owners to deliver tailored solutions that support business requirements, create a superlative user experience, and drive tangible business value.
• Pro-actively identify opportunities to leverage Salesforce in innovative ways to improve existing business processes, increase productivity, and support an organization scaling at a rapid pace.
• Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, and SMEs to support major project roll-outs, including training and troubleshooting for end-users.
• Manage Salesforce support requests and any escalated administrative needs of users by providing prompt and complete resolution to technical challenges and business support issues.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS or equivalent experience
• 3+ years of experience working with enterprise level Salesforce instance (300+ users)
• 3+ years Salesforce Admin/Configuration experience
• Salesforce Administrator Certification

Preferred Qualifications
• Salesforce Advanced Administrator (ADM-211) Certification
• Strong business analysis and functional experience, including requirements gathering, creating/deploying solutions to end users, and managing UAT/deployment process
• In-depth understanding of the capabilities and constraints of the SFDC CRM application architecture coupled with a good understanding around the business processes (Sales, Marketing, Operations, etc.)
• Experience with basic Salesforce API connections for Salesforce native apps (ex. Quip), AppExchange products, and data pipelines (ex. Informatica, S3)
• Understanding of Scrum, Agile, and CI/CD development frameworks

We offer
• Permanent contract with Beyondsoft
• Full time contract from (40 hours week) Monday to Friday
• Remote work from Spain
• 25 days of holidays
• The opportunity to join a pioneer IT company and be part of the European expansion.
• And other benefits to be discussed during the first interview
